note: Every wicket kind the Cricsheet archive uses, and what each one is to the scorecard. The go-app importer (internal/wicketkinds) and the rating pass (ml/xi/wicketkinds.py) both read this file, so a bowler's wickets in bowling_data and his wickets target agree kind for kind, and an innings' wickets_lost and the pass's dismissal count agree ball for ball (IMPORT-06). A kind not listed here fails the import and the pass rather than being counted by guesswork; Cricsheet adding one is an edit to this file.
